answer: Proof of commercial pilot medical certificate via aviation medical examiner record is a logbook of the same kind: a certificate the aviation examiner has signed at every annual check. An airfield's flight log lists every takeoff by tail number and pilot; a plane that never flew has no log at all. The cipher is the medical, a doctor's signature beside each renewal — one false year needs a pen, a hundred need a hundred checkups, and the hollow is the clinic's appointment book, the willow its filing cabinet, kept for the inspectors.
